description.value:
In place of an attack action, you can twirl your extended flight feathers. When you do this, you fly up 5ft in the air and then each creature within a 5ft radius of you must make a Dexterity (Save) check of DC 8 + your Constitution Modifier + your Proficiency or be battered by the rapidly spinning propeller feathers. They take 1d8 + DEX slashing damage on failure, and half damage on success.
This damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
You can use Wicked Wind a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
